Description.SourceString:
It is scant, but there is inspiration to find in the Manafem tribe. They are besieged by Fuzan, his Mark, the KotHaar, sandstorms, dragons and kalphite. Every day is a new tragedy, as gossip spreads of a child lost to the Dearg Due, or a scouting party taken to the Vault. They live underground, where very little light reaches them, which is apt, as there is little joy that can reach them there too. 

But they persist. Something inside makes them. Perhaps it is because they have outlived so many of their oppressors; their sheer resilience gives them something like hope. Or maybe they share a fascination in what else could go wrong. Whatever it is, the Manafem stand firm, even when their flesh is being flogged from them.
